title: 射頻濾波器與雙工器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究聲學濾波、損失與收發隔離；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate acoustic filtering, loss and transmit/receive isolation. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

knowledge.textEn: Qloaded=f₀/BW₃dB; insertion loss IL=−20log₁₀abs(S21). Loaded Q of an approximate single bandpass; not intrinsic material Q or a commercial product specification.

quiz.question: 審查「量產判據」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for production criteria?
options: 只量一個中心頻點可代表全部通帶。
只有中心頻率相同即可替換濾波器。
保存校準面與溫度條件下的完整掃頻。
optionsEn: One center-frequency measurement represents the entire passband.
Matching center frequency alone permits replacement.
Retain full sweeps with calibration-plane and temperature conditions.
quiz.explanation: 通帶、阻帶、相位和溫漂須共同建立容差遮罩。 保存校準面與溫度條件下的完整掃頻。
quiz.explanationEn: Passband, stopband, phase and drift need a joint tolerance mask. Retain full sweeps with calibration-plane and temperature conditions.
